name: voxel-mapping-tool
description: Evidence-first 1:1 Minecraft Bedrock theme-park reconstruction compiler

scripts.ci: npm test && npm run build:fixture && npm run validate:fixture
scripts.build:fixture: node src/cli.mjs build --park-name "Fixture Park" --osm test/fixtures/mini-park.overpass.json --planning test/fixtures/planning-authority.geojson --bbox 51.0000,-0.0020,51.0020,0.0020 --elevation none --planning-world-authority planning-only --accuracy-mode verified --buildings markers --no-addon --no-preview --out out/fixture
scripts.validate:fixture: node scripts/validate-world.mjs --world out/fixture/fixture-park_1to1.mcworld --manifest out/fixture/world-manifest.json --labels out/fixture/building-labels.json --geojson out/fixture/fixture-park.geojson --out out/fixture/world-validation.json
